statement: An employer must establish at least one retirement-benefit scheme for retiring workers, except for workers with under one year of continuous service or an average of under 15 prescribed weekly working hours over four weeks (Guarantee of Workers’ Retirement Benefits Act Article 4(1)). A severance-pay (퇴직금) scheme must provide at least 30 days of average wages per year of continuous service (Article 8(1)), and on separation the employer must settle wages and all other amounts within 14 days unless the parties agree to extend (Labor Standards Act Article 36).
caveat: Defined-benefit or defined-contribution retirement-pension schemes satisfy the duty in place of lump-sum severance where adopted with worker-representative consent; interim settlement is limited to decree-listed grounds (Article 8(2)). Severance itself is payable within 14 days of the payment cause arising, extendable by agreement, and generally lands in the worker’s individual retirement-pension account (Article 9).
